sections.title: THE GOAL
sections.body: Grow your market share to the majority target before any rival. Research (experiments + confirmed discoveries) is the engine; acquisitions, contracts, espionage and facilities are accelerators. You can also win through full scientific completion (Distinguished Researcher) or by crushing every rival (The Monopoly). Lose if a rival takes majority, if you go insolvent three days running (acquired), or if your roster is wiped out.

sections.title: RESEARCH
sections.body: Pick an artifact, assign scientists, run experiments to raise knowledge. At 30% a discovery is SUSPECTED; at 70% it CONFIRMS (or gather 4 matching evidence observations for secondaries). Confirmations pay market share and unlock technologies. Queue one experiment per scientist per day, then Run Day. Rest stressed scientists (stress over 70 hurts quality).

sections.title: RIVALS & MARKET
sections.body: Four rivals grow every day; HELIOS is fastest. Watch them in Rival Intelligence. Slow them with sabotage and exposes, buy them out (needs 10% standing, board approval weekly), or outgrow them 2.5-to-1. Wildcards can implode; leaders absorb weaklings.

sections.title: MONEY & DEALS
sections.body: Experiments and overhead burn cash daily; grants arrive on schedule. Acquire labs (check diligence first), sign one contract at a time, build facilities, hire from candidates when someone dies. Going broke three days straight gets Janus acquired — which opens a hidden second chance.

sections.title: DANGER
sections.body: Radioactive and crisis work injures people. INJURED scientists work poorly; the dead stay dead (memorialized). Keep cover up, resolve crises fast, and never let all three starters die with no hires waiting.
